journey.name: Receive a Lightning payment over Ark
journey.description: Precondition: onboarded signet wallet with Ark enabled. Pay the invoice from https://signet.2nd.dev/ when prompted.

actions.action: Verify that the wallet home screen is shown
Verify that a QR code and a Lightning invoice starting with "lntbs" are shown
Pay the displayed invoice from the signet faucet, then close the receive screen
Verify that the Spending balance on the home screen is greater than 0
Verify that the activity list shows a received payment for the amount that was paid
